name: Adrian Chiarella
bio: Adrian Chiarella is an Australian writer and director. He is best known for his debut feature film, Leviticus (2026), which premiered in the Midnight section of the Sundance Film Festival. He also directed episodes of Totally Completely Fine (2023) and Five Bedrooms, and won the 2025 AWGIE Award for his Erotic Stories episode "Walking Gambit."

credits.title: Leviticus
credits.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

credits.overview: A lonely, awkward teenager encounters a male sex worker on a morning in suburban Sydney. Based on the short story "Concealer" by Andy Boreham.

credits.title: The Gift
credits.overview: Evoking the mystery and menace of the Australian landscape THE GIFT tells the story of a busy father who is forced by his curious child, Louise, to re-evaluate that which is important in life.

credits.title: Almost
credits.overview: Emily and Tom meet and have a magnetic connection. They almost fall very much in love, however, fate intervenes and they can never be together.

credits.title: Ostia: The Last Night
credits.overview: A dark story of desire and betrayal inspired by the events of the night of the brutal slaying of Italian filmmaker Pier Paolo Pasolini.

credits.title: Mogadishu Dreaming
credits.overview: A short documentary about Ahmed Hagi, a gay Somali artist who fled his war torn country to Sydney, Australia where he now spends his days painting idealized visions of Mogadishu before it fell under the control of gangs and warlords.
